form.current-chamber: IN THE SENATE OF THE UNITED STATES

action.action-desc: Mr. McCormick (for himself and Mr. Hickenlooper) introduced the following bill; which was read twice and referred to the Committee on Agriculture, Nutrition, and Forestry

form.official-title: To amend the Food, Agriculture, Conservation, and Trade Act of 1990 to reauthorize the Genome to Phenome Initiative.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Genome to Phenome Initiative Reauthorization Act of 2026 or the AG2PI Act of 2026.

section.header: Reauthorization of Genome to Phenome Initiative
section.text: Section 1671(g) of the Food, Agriculture, Conservation, and Trade Act of 1990 (7 U.S.C. 5924(g)) is amended by striking 2023 and inserting 2031.
